newsitem.title: USA: Georgia seeks PL-480 U.S. HRW wheat - export agent.
newsitem.headline: Georgia seeks PL-480 U.S. HRW wheat - export agent.

text.p: Georgia was seeking two cargoes of up to 65,000 tonnes each of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL-480 export program, its U.S. shipping agent, Fettig and Donalty Inc, said.
The agent had announced the tender early this week.
Offers will be opened in public on August 20, the agent said.
One cargo of up to 65,000 tonnes was slated for September 10-30 delivery and another cargo of up to 65,000 tonnes was set for November 10-30 delivery.
